name: olahome
description: OlaHome: public listings of homes in Japan for foreign residents. Read-only: search listings, view one listing, and learn about OlaHome services.

interface.shortDescription: Homes in Japan for foreign residents: public listings, read-only
interface.longDescription: Connects to the public, read-only OlaHome MCP server (https://olahome.jp/mcp). Searches approved public OlaHome listings in Japan, returns one listing by its public ID, and describes OlaHome services and their legal limits. It never books or reserves a room, and availability is not real-time.
